d: The India Alliance mega rally is currently underway in the national capital Delhi under the leadership of Rahul Gandhi, with prominent leaders including Akhilesh Yadav, Mamata Banerjee, Mallikarjun Kharge and other major opposition figures participating. Large crowds are visible as the procession moves from Connaught Place to Ramlila Maidan, with organizers claiming attendance of up to 10 lakh people. Supporters and leaders are demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar while Khabargaon provides continuous ground reports from the ongoing political gathering.
